home.roomsTitle: Three rooms for the money you have not spent yet
home.roomsSub: Reference rates, a plain-English guide to saving and risk, and ways students earn on the side. The first two are reference information only — the last one is a library of ideas, each with a source.
home.room1b: Savings and Fixed Deposit rates from different banks, side by side, with the date they were recorded.

home.room3b: Tutoring, freelancing and campus reselling, curated by staff and marked where a source exists.
